purpose: Traceable public AWS F2 HBM IP snapshot and explicit Ramulator HBM2 modeling assumptions; no claim of AMD controller timing equivalence.
timing_units_evidence: USER_HBM_TCK_0_PERIOD=1.1111111111111112 ns; USER_tRFC_0=0x13B=315 memory cycles gives350ns, matching AMD PG2768H tRFC. USER_MC0_REF_CMD_PERIOD=0xDB6=3510 memory cycles gives3.9us.

model_choices.nCL: Use nCL=22 as an explicit interpretation of XCI USER_RL_0=0x16, not independently verified against the initialization ROM. The public HBM_xsim model decodes raw MR2 RL bits as raw+2, but the inspected wrappers do not establish whether USER_RL is already decoded. This excludes AMD AXI, crossbar and CDC latency.
model_choices.nCWL: Use nCWL=7 as an explicit interpretation of XCI USER_WL_0=0x07, not independently verified against the initialization ROM. The public HBM_xsim model decodes raw MR2 WL bits as raw+1, but the inspected wrappers do not establish whether USER_WL is already decoded. This is not physical per-request write completion.
model_choices.tCK_ps: 1111 integerps approximates exact10000/9ps; modeled clock is about100ppm faster.
model_choices.nBL: 2 DRAM cycles from fixed BL4 and DDR transfer.
model_choices.nCCDS: 2 nCK from the pinned AMD hbm_parameter.v.
model_choices.nCCDL: 4 nCK from the pinned AMD hbm_parameter.v.
model_choices.nCCDR: 3 nCK from the pinned AMD hbm_parameter.v; replaces the upstream Ramulator SID2 estimate of 2.
model_choices.nRTW: 21 from the upstream expression 22+2-7+ceil(0.3+(3500+tDQSQ_ps)/1111). Both neighboring 1600/2000 Mbps tDQSQ=106/85 ps yield 21; the upstream table does not specify 1800 Mbps.
model_choices.nREFIpb: floor3510/32=109 theoretical per-bank interval; not used by selected AllBank manager.
model_choices.refresh: Ramulator AllBank policy differs from AWS XCI enabled single-bank refresh/lookahead and SBREF_ISSUE_PER30.
model_choices.address_mapping: Selected adapter stripes32B across physical channels then uses RoBaRaCoCh; this differs from the AWS address map above.
model_choices.controller: Ramulator HBM12 FRFCFS/open page/32-entry read+write queues. AMD AXI IDs, reorder queue, crossbar contention, ingress port rate, CDC, ECC and PHY behavior are not reproduced.

sources.supports: Device, capacity, clocks, selected raw timings and controller/address settings.
Published simulation timing constants tCCDS=2, tCCDL=4, tCCDR=3 nCK.
Eight physical channels/stack, two64-bit pseudochannels/channel, BL4.
AMD crossbar and backpressure losses absent from generic DRAM replay.
Native HBM2 hierarchy,32Bpayload, timing-resolution formula and explicit guessed timings.
